page.layout: One page of text. Running head and page number at the top. Above the text, an italic summary block of four lines and a closing line of the summary, full width. Main text in one column, paragraph set in justified lines, catchword "non" at the lower right. No margin notes.

p.i: Illustrat modum exemplo Catonis: qui ab amicitia Q.[?] Pompeij Lælij nomine se removerat: propter dissentionem autem, quæ erat in Repub. alienatus est a Q.[?] Metello: utrumq; egit graviter authoritate & sine offensione acerba. Unde modum amicitiæ dissolvendæ repetit.

main_text.p: Omninò omnium horū vitiorum, atq; incommodorum una cautio est, atq; una prouisio, ut ne nimis cito diligere incipiamus, neue indignos. Digni autem sunt amicitia, quibus in ipsis inest causa cur diligantur. Rarum genus (& quidem omnia præclara rara) nec quicquam difficilius, quam reperire, quod sit omni ex parte in suo genere perfectū. Sed plerique neq; in rebus humanis quicquam bonum norunt, nisi quod fructuosum sit: & amicos, tanquam pecudes, eos potissimū diligunt, ex quibus sperat se maximum fructum esse capturos. Itaq; pulcherrima illa, & maxime naturali caret amicitia, per se, & propter se expetenda, nec sibi ipsi exemplo sunt, hæc vis amicitiæ qualis, & quanta sit. Ipse enim se quisq; diligit non

page.notes: The Q. abbreviations in the summary are printed as a Q with a stroke (Quintus); marked [?]. The first line of the summary, "Illustrat", is a summary of the chapter's argument in italics above the text, not a heading. The word "rara)" closes a parenthesis as printed. No marginal notes, no catchword other than "non" at the foot.
